items.exampleEn: The goal caused an eruption of cheers from the crowd.
items.exampleZh: 那一球讓觀眾爆出一陣歡呼。

items.exampleEn: I'm sorry for the intrusion, but I need to ask you a quick question.
items.exampleZh: 抱歉打擾了，不過我需要問你一個簡短的問題。

items.exampleEn: The sag in the roof showed that the wood was old.
items.exampleZh: 屋頂往下凹陷，看得出木頭已經老舊了。

items.exampleEn: Her anger subsided after a cup of tea.
items.exampleZh: 喝了一杯茶後，她的怒氣消了。

items.exampleEn: Because of an overlap in the schedule, two meetings were in the same room.
items.exampleZh: 因為行程重疊，兩場會議排在同一個房間。

items.exampleEn: Our team overtook the leaders in the last week of the season.
items.exampleZh: 我們隊在球季最後一週超越了領先的隊伍。

items.exampleEn: This bag has a zip inside for small things like keys.
items.exampleZh: 這個包包裡面有一個拉鍊袋，可以放鑰匙之類的小東西。

items.exampleEn: She spent the summer honing her piano skills.
items.exampleZh: 她花了一整個夏天磨練鋼琴技巧。

items.sentenceEn: The chef honed his knife before cutting the fish.
items.sentenceZh: 主廚在切魚之前先把刀磨利。

items.audioEn: A truck tried to overtake us on the narrow road, so my father slowed down.
items.audioZh: 一輛卡車想在窄路上超我們的車，所以我爸爸放慢了速度。
options: He saw a police car behind
A dog ran across the road

items.sentenceEn: There was an eruption of laughter when the cat jumped onto the piano.
items.sentenceZh: 貓跳上鋼琴時，大家爆出一陣笑聲。

items.sentenceEn: The old bed has a deep sag in the middle.
items.sentenceZh: 那張舊床的中間凹陷得很深。

items.stemEn: The ____ on my jacket is stuck, so I can't take it off.
items.stemZh: 我外套的拉鍊卡住了，所以脫不下來。

items.stemEn: After an hour, the strong wind finally began to ____.
items.stemZh: 一個小時後，強風終於開始減弱。

items.passageEn: Last summer, we visited an island with a volcano. Our guide told us that the last eruption happened about seventy years ago, and that the black rocks under our feet were old lava. She also said that the tourist season and the rainy season overlap, so many visitors get wet. At one point, a group of loud tourists caused an intrusion into a quiet bird area, and she politely asked them to leave. On the way back, a fast boat overtook our small ferry.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們去了一座有火山的島。導遊告訴我們，上一次噴發大約在七十年前，我們腳下的黑色岩石就是以前的熔岩。她也說，觀光季和雨季重疊，所以很多遊客都會淋溼。途中有一群吵鬧的遊客闖進安靜的賞鳥區，她很有禮貌地請他們離開。回程時，一艘快艇超過了我們的小渡輪。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼很多遊客會淋溼？

items.promptZh: 這兩門課的內容有些重疊。
referenceEn: There is some overlap between the two courses.
The two courses have some overlap in their content.
rubricZh: 要用 overlap（例如名詞 some overlap between…；當動詞 overlap 也可以）
「有些」可寫，例如 some、a little 等

items.promptZh: 這件洋裝的拉鍊在背後，很難自己拉上。
referenceEn: The zip on this dress is at the back, so it's hard to close by myself.
This dress has a zip at the back, which makes it hard to do up by myself.
rubricZh: zip 當名詞「拉鍊」（例如 the zip on this dress、has a zip at the back 等）；寫 zipper 也正確
「拉上」可寫，例如 close、do up、zip up 等
「自己」可寫，例如 by myself、on my own 等
